title: BMA executor tool types
description: Tool dispatch, results, cancellation, and artifact references.

ToolName.description: Built-in tool names. bmad serves bash only and answers -32012 for the rest.

ComputerAction.description: Input actions accepted by the computer_action tool. mouse_move, hold_key, wait and batch are contract 1.17.0 (additive); clipboard_read and clipboard_write are contract 1.24.0 (additive).

PermissionMode.description: Tool permission mode; always_ask means the harness already resolved approval.

ToolPermission.description: Tool permission resolved by the harness.

ToolInput.description: Superset of every built-in tool input, decoded by executors that read input generically. tool.call selects the exact per-tool schema through x-bma-params-discriminator; unknown members are ignored.

BashInput.description: bash input: run command with a login shell.

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the session workspace.

timeout_ms.description: Per-call timeout; the executor default applies when absent.

ReadInput.description: read input: return lines of a text file.

path.description: File path, relative to the session workspace.

WriteInput.description: write input: create or replace a file.

path.description: File path, relative to the session workspace.

EditInput.description: edit input: replace the single occurrence of old_string.

path.description: File path, relative to the session workspace.

old_string.description: Text that must occur exactly once.

GlobInput.description: glob input: list paths matching pattern.

path.description: Base directory, relative to the session workspace.

GrepInput.description: grep input: search file lines with a regular expression.

path.description: Directory to search, relative to the session workspace.
Directory, relative to the session workspace.

ComputerObserveInput.description: computer_observe input. The result is a screenshot (an image content block) with the list of the screen's windows as text. pid and window_id (both or neither, contract 1.8.0) observe one window of that list. region (contract 1.17.0) zooms: the result is that part of the screenshot at full screen resolution.

pid.description: Contract 1.8.0. Process id of the window to observe (with window_id).

window_id.description: Additive. Window id from the window list (with pid).

region.description: Contract 1.17.0. [x0, y0, x1, y1]: the top-left and bottom-right corners, in pixels of the last screenshot of the same target, of the area to return at full resolution (zoom). Coordinates of later actions stay those of the full screenshot.

ComputerActionInput.description: computer_action input, after Anthropic's computer-use tool over the ComputerAction enum. Coordinates are pixels of the last computer_observe screenshot (window-local with pid and window_id). The members after display are contract 1.8.0 (additive). duration and actions are contract 1.17.0: action batch with actions runs those steps in order, stops at the first failure and ends with a screenshot of the last step's target (the screen, or its window).

coordinate.description: [x, y] for click, scroll and the end of drag.

text.description: Text to type (any language), or a key or chord such as Return or ctrl+s; for clipboard_write the text to put on the clipboard.

pid.description: Process id of the target window (with window_id).

window_id.description: Target window id (with pid); input then goes to that window in the background.

duration.description: Contract 1.17.0. Seconds to hold the keys (hold_key) or to wait (wait).

actions.description: Contract 1.17.0. The steps of action batch (each a computer_action input other than batch), run in order; the first failure stops the batch and the rest are not executed. The result reports every step and ends with a screenshot of the last step's target.

ContentBlock.description: Tool result content block. An artifact block carries artifact_id and mime_type instead of text (v1.1 §6.5).

ArtifactRef.description: Artifact reference returned by POST /v1/environments/{environment_id}/artifacts (legacy alias POST /v1/executors/artifacts) and listed in tool.result artifacts (v1.1 §6.5).

ToolResultFile.description: Contract 1.26.0. A session file a tool call created (agent.tool_result.bma_files, GenerateImageResult.files). The file is readable with GET /v1/files/{file_id}/content like any session file.

filename.description: File name (last segment of its output path).

model.description: The model that generated the file (generated files only).

GenerateImageInput.description: Contract 1.26.0. Input of the platform tool generate_image. The platform offers it with model as an enum of the turn's available image models (contracts/bma/platform-tool-image.vectors.json); format (PNG) and count (1) are the platform's; the platform requests resolution 2K, which only models that declare a resolution parameter honor (OpenAI gpt-image-* output follows aspect_ratio, 1024x1024 for 1:1).

prompt.description: What to create or how to change the input image: subject, style, composition, lighting, exact text in quotes; for an edit, what must stay the same.

images.description: Input images: absolute paths in the session's uploads or outputs directory, or file ids (file_…). The first is the image to edit, the others are references. Each at most 20 MB and 16,777,216 pixels.

aspect_ratio.description: Width:height of the image; auto lets the model choose. The platform offers these values as an enum.

model.description: Image model id; one of the turn's available image models. Absent: the default image model.

name.description: File name stem, for example hero-banner.

description.description: One line telling the user what is being made.

GenerateImageResult.description: Contract 1.26.0. structuredContent of a generate_image answer (its outputSchema). The answer's content is a text (paths, file ids, sizes, model, revised prompt) and, per image, a preview image (at most 1024 px, annotations.audience [assistant]) plus this object serialized as text.

error_code.description: Open set: content_policy_violation, invalid_image_input, rate_limited, image_model_unavailable, image_model_not_allowed, billing_suspended and the platform tool codes (permission_denied, approval_required, approval_invalid, in_progress, idempotency_key_reused).

files.description: The generated images: session output files at output_path generated/<name>.png, also mounted at <session root>/uploads/generated/<name>.png.

cost_usd.description: The provider-reported cost (usage.cost) when it reported one.

available_models.description: With image_model_not_allowed: the models the call may name.

GenerateImageInputRef.description: Contract 1.26.0. An input image of a generate_image call as sent: its file and content digest.

WebSearchInput.description: Contract 2.1.0. Input of the platform tool web_search (agent_toolset_20260401): a web search the platform runs with its own provider. The turn offers exactly this schema.

recency.description: Only results published within this period.

allowed_domains.description: Only results from these domains and their subdomains; not with blocked_domains.

blocked_domains.description: No results from these domains and their subdomains; not with allowed_domains.

locale.description: Language and country to favor (zh-CN, en-US).

snippet.description: At most 600 characters of the page's text.

published_at.description: When the page was published, when the provider knows it.

WebSearchResult.description: Contract 2.1.0. structuredContent of a web_search answer. The answer's text lists the same results as [n] title — url (published date) and snippet, inside <untrusted_web_content source="web_search"> … </untrusted_web_content> (the tag escaped inside the results), after a line telling the model the block is external data and to cite sources as markdown links.

error_code.description: Open set: url_not_allowed, unsupported_content_type, content_too_large, fetch_failed, search_unavailable, rate_limited, max_uses_exceeded, billing_suspended and the platform tool codes (permission_denied, approval_required, approval_invalid, in_progress, idempotency_key_reused).

provider.description: The search provider that answered (exa, bocha, brave, exa-keyless).

WebFetchInput.description: Contract 2.1.0. Input of the platform tool web_fetch (agent_toolset_20260401): a public page the platform fetches through its SSRF guard (every connection and redirect hop to a public address only; at most 5 redirects; robots.txt respected; no cookies or credentials; 5 MB and 20 s at most; HTML, text, markdown, JSON and XML only; no JavaScript).

url.description: An http or https URL without credentials.

WebFetchResult.description: Contract 2.1.0. structuredContent of a web_fetch answer. The answer's text names the final URL, title and content type and carries the extracted content inside <untrusted_web_content source="<final_url>"> … </untrusted_web_content> (the tag escaped inside the content).

error_code.description: Open set: url_not_allowed, unsupported_content_type, content_too_large, fetch_failed, search_unavailable, rate_limited, max_uses_exceeded, billing_suspended and the platform tool codes (permission_denied, approval_required, approval_invalid, in_progress, idempotency_key_reused).

truncated.description: The content was cut at max_chars.
